All cited tokens decoded (cited 5, decoded 5, undecoded none).
No cited label was not shown to the agent.
None of the citations were not decoded.
the report cites only labels that were shown; nothing is outside the shown labels
every token decoded, so no token was never shown

request_texts.name: meaning
request_texts.text: Each row is what the native adapter recorded when that episode's agent submitted its report: cited is how many evidence tokens the report cited, decoded is how many of them were obs-N labels the agent had been shown and so were decoded to the evidence ID of an observation delivered to it, and undecoded lists every cited token that was not decoded and was kept exactly as written (all three are null when no complete native adapter v2.1 citation record was recorded for that episode).

request_texts.name: memory_pointer
request_texts.text: This request's native_citation_status block lists, for each episode in its evidence, the adapter's recorded outcome of that decoding: how many tokens the report cited, how many decoded to delivered evidence, and any token kept as written.

request_texts.name: v2_memory_sentence_1
request_texts.text: Fresh native agent and empty native memory for each episode.

request_texts.name: v2_memory_sentence_2
request_texts.text: The agent is shown each observation's evidence_id as a short label obs-N, numbered 1, 2, 3, ...

request_texts.name: v2_memory_sentence_3
request_texts.text: in the order the observations were first shown to it; an observation it was never shown (for example the first attempt of a write the broker retried inside one tool call, or a policy step's read that did not block) gets no label.

request_texts.name: v2_memory_sentence_4
request_texts.text: When it submits its report, each cited label it had been shown is decoded back to the full evidence ID before validation, and any other cited token is kept exactly as written.

request_texts.name: v2_memory_sentence_5
request_texts.text: So a report in these records cites the same full evidence IDs as the recorded observations; a token kept as written is one the agent was never shown as a label, and it fails the evidence check.

request_texts.name: v2_memory_sentence_6
request_texts.text: In an evidence summary a report citation oN means the Nth observation row of that episode; that numbering counts every recorded observation, including ones the agent never saw, so it can differ from the agent's obs-N.

note: A counted match in a v2 memory sentence is the known limit: a Mechanic repeating that unchanged rule text would count, and only the human check of claim_matches sentences catches it.
